prompt:
We need a polished investor pitch deck for NexaPay ready for our Series A roadshow next week. All the content is in `data/company_brief.json` — company background, slide-by-slide content, brand colors, typography, and the exact output filename to use.

The deck should have 5 slides covering: our title/brand, the problem we solve, our product solution (with icons for each feature), our traction with a bar chart showing monthly volume growth, and a closing fundraising slide.

Please build this from scratch as a proper .pptx file using the filename specified in the brief. Make it visually sharp — the brand team flagged that our last deck looked generic and text-heavy. Each slide should feel designed, not just typed.
